settings.title: Settings
settings.keysHint: A key is submitted once over HTTPS, stored encrypted server-side, never kept or echoed here; revoke any time.
settings.threadHint: New conversations use the model and approval policy set here. Conversations already open are not affected.

policy.on-request: On request: ask when Codex asks
policy.on-failure: On failure: ask only when the sandbox fails

settings.sandboxHint: Register a model key in Settings, then create your cloud sandbox. The first creation returns your agent token once.
settings.sandboxCapacityFull: Cloud sandboxes are at capacity right now. Please try again later; your key and settings are kept.
settings.reconnectHint: This replaces both the computer token and the cloud sandbox token: the old computer disconnects and a running sandbox restarts for a few dozen seconds
settings.sandboxRolled: The cloud sandbox is using the new token and is restarting
settings.rotateHint: The old tokens are revoked at the relay right away; the new command is shown once and a running sandbox rolls automatically.
settings.noticeProvisioned: Sandbox startup requested. Copy the token and initialize locally; it cannot be viewed again after refresh.
settings.noticeUpdated: Updated: the sandbox restarts with the new settings (about a minute), showing "Starting" then "Running". Your local agent needs nothing.
settings.noticeRestored: Restored: the sandbox is starting and your earlier work is kept. Your local agent does not need to reconnect.
settings.noticeDeleted: Removed: the sandbox is stopped and your work is kept. Start it again any time; no new command will be issued.
settings.noticeRotated: The old token is revoked. Initialize locally with the new token, then start the agent.
settings.confirmRotate: This replaces both the computer token and the cloud sandbox token: the old computer disconnects and a running sandbox restarts for a few dozen seconds. Continue?
settings.confirmDelete: Removing stops the sandbox (your work is kept) and sessions pause until you start it again. Remove it?
settings.copyManual: Automatic copying is unavailable. The text is selected; press Ctrl+C.
settings.agentTokenHint: Run this command in local PowerShell, then paste the token into the hidden prompt.
settings.lead: Register your model key and choose defaults for new conversations. Install agents and manage sandboxes in My computers.
settings.machineEntryHint: The cloud sandbox only starts, updates and is removed here. Connecting a computer is in My computer below.

home.title: What do you want to work out today?

chat.name: Chat
chat.what: Question and answer. It can query our data; it does not touch files on your machine.

work.name: Work
work.what: Let it act in your project folder: read files, run commands, change files. You approve what matters.

expert.name: Expert
expert.what: Follows a fixed method step by step, checks every step, and hands back a dossier. Slower and costlier.

pick.chat: A chat does not need a project. With one, it can read the files in that project.
pick.work: Work happens inside a project: a folder on your machine.
pick.expert: The expert takes over the whole project: this conversation, its files, other conversations and dossiers.

list.title: Projects
list.lead: A project is a folder on your computer, plus what you chatted about, worked on, and what experts handed back around it.
list.none: No projects in this workspace yet.

noWorkspace.title: No workspace yet
noWorkspace.lead: A workspace is a root folder on your machine. Having none usually has one of these three causes:
noWorkspace.sandbox: No sandbox yet: register a model key in Settings, then start the sandbox in My computers.
noWorkspace.agent: No local agent connected yet: install the local agent on your machine and add a folder in it.
noWorkspace.account: Signed in with a different account: the local agent and the web page must use the same account.
noWorkspace.note: Workspaces are added and removed in the local agent on your machine, not on the web.

create.title: New project
create.pathHint: A folder relative to the workspace. Leave empty for the workspace itself. If the folder does not exist yet, it is created the first time work happens in it.
create.name: Project name
create.nameHint: Left empty, the last part of the folder is used: {title}

problem.absolute: The subfolder must be relative to the workspace, not an absolute path.
problem.upward: The subfolder must not go upwards (no ..).
problem.project_exists: This folder is already a project.
problem.root_outside_whitelist: This workspace is not whitelisted on that machine.

create.machinesFailed: Could not load computers. Try reloading; no project was created.
create.noMachine: Connect a computer and choose a directory before creating a project.
create.noRoots: This computer has no shared directories. Add and select directories in the local tray, save, then reopen this dialog.

page.lead: A project is a folder on your computer, plus what you chatted about, worked on, and what experts handed back around it.
page.offlineNote: The machine is offline: you can look and chat, but not start work or ask an expert.
page.empty: Nothing in this project yet. Start with the three buttons above.
page.archiveBody: Once archived it no longer appears in the sidebar and the project list. Conversations and dossiers stay and it can be unarchived. Files on your computer are not affected.
page.problem: It did not work. Please try again.

head.running: The expert is still working. Finished steps are below; the rest are not there yet.
head.noData: There is no data for this company yet. Handle it in the conversation: request ingestion, then continue.
head.refused: The expert did not take this on.
head.stopped: Not finished. Finished steps are shown as usual; the rest say "not reached". What was spent stays on record.

how.detail: Click a step to see what it handed back and every acceptance check

conclusion.title: My conclusion

conclusion.placeholder: What do you make of it?

dossier.showDetail: Show the detail of every number: basis, formula, source

machines.title: My computers
machines.lead: Work and Expert read and write projects on your own computer. A local agent runs there and lets us touch only the folders you whitelisted.
machines.offlineNote: The agent is offline. Check the reason in the local tray and start it; if logon startup is enabled it starts after login.
machines.noRoots: No folder added yet. Add one in the local agent so projects have a place.

ceiling.title: The limits this machine sets for itself

sandbox.workspace-write: can change files only inside whitelisted folders

ceiling.note: These can only be changed on that machine. The web page shows them and cannot change them; however much we allow, it cannot go beyond them.

guide.title: Connect a computer
guide.connect: On the computer choose Connect my account, then enter the code here
guide.evidence: An online computer means these three steps are done.
guide.onlineHint: Status updates every 5 seconds. Return to Work or Expert once the computer is online.

connect.title: Connect a computer
connect.hint: Eight characters. They are uppercased and a hyphen is inserted after the fourth.
connect.wrong: The code is wrong or expired

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.unlock: After downloading, right-click the ZIP, open Properties, check Unblock, extract, then double-click Install. This is not the main path.
advanced.copyFailed: Copy did not succeed. Try again.

setup.downloadFailed: Download information could not be loaded. No sandbox or token was changed.
setup.copyHint: Paste it into PowerShell and press Enter. It works for 10 minutes and only once
setup.tooFast: That was too fast. Wait and try again
setup.packageInfo: Version {version} · Codex {codex} · Windows x64 · Download {size} MiB
setup.installHint: Save the ZIP as windows-x64.zip in Downloads and run this in ordinary PowerShell. Verify the source and hashes first. An existing destination stops installation. Do not disable system protection if blocked.
setup.developmentOnly: Development-site package. Clean Windows and real reboot acceptance are still pending before public release.
setup.startTitle: Choose directories and start after initialization
setup.startHint: Complete local initialization above, then open tray settings, add and select project directories, save and start. Logon startup is an explicit tray option.
setup.oneMachine: Only one agent may be online per account. Connecting another replaces the existing connection.
setup.unknownExpiry: Not issued or a legacy token with no recorded expiry
setup.refreshRequired: The identity changed or an operation is still running. Status was refreshed. Review it before explicitly trying again; no automatic rotation occurs.
setup.needKey: Register a model key in Settings first, then create your sandbox to receive the first token.
setup.operationFailed: Operation not confirmed ({code}). Check status before retrying. If the first token was lost, explicitly request a replacement.
setup.statusFailed: Status could not be loaded. Actions are disabled; refresh the page to retry.
setup.tokenCopied: Copied. Paste only into the hidden local initialization prompt; clear the clipboard afterwards.
setup.tokenMemory: Shown on this page once, cleared after five minutes, navigation or refresh. Do not paste into chat or command arguments. Copying uses the system clipboard; avoid cross-device clipboard synchronization.
setup.afterInit: The command prompts for hidden token input locally. Then follow the next step, “Choose directories and start after initialization”.

library.title: Library
library.lead: Your materials with us. Working papers handed back by experts and files returned by work appear here automatically; each one has a copy on the server that belongs only to you. Files on your computer are not here; experts read them on your machine.
library.failed: Could not load; try again later.
library.emptyHint: Working papers and returned files will appear here automatically. Uploading your own files comes later.
library.notFoundHint: Try another word or clear the filter.
library.note: Only filed materials are here. Removing takes an item out of the library; the conversation and working paper stay.

item.notFound: No such item, or it was removed from the library.
item.copy: This item has a copy on the server that belongs only to you.
item.confirmRemove: It will no longer show here; the conversation and working paper stay. Sure?
item.failed: That did not work; try again.
